review: Independent read-only algebra review confirmed convention, remainder, affine coefficient identity, orthogonality and every reported fraction. Reviewer did not execute scripts.
scope: Exact mathematical toy results; no neural, Adam, clipping, multistep or capability evidence.
norm_convention: Use one common Euclidean vector norm and its induced matrix operator norm. Each Hessian Lipschitz constant is defined in that induced operator norm along its respective update segment.
